data.notes: August 2026 is anchored by Vibrez Festival’s late-month run at Meštrović Gallery, with select Split Summer Festival chamber concerts earlier in the month.

events.title: Vibrez Festival 2026: Mogwai
events.summary: Scottish post-rock band Mogwai opens the Meštrović Gallery cycle of Vibrez Festival 2026. The concert is listed for 20:00 at Galerija Meštrović in Split.

events.title: Vibrez Festival 2026: Morcheeba
events.summary: British downtempo and trip-hop band Morcheeba closes the August Meštrović Gallery run of Vibrez Festival 2026. The concert is confirmed for 20:00 at Galerija Meštrović in Split.

events.title: Vibrez Festival 2026: Mariza
events.summary: Portuguese fado singer Mariza performs as part of Vibrez Festival 2026. The concert is confirmed for 20:00 at Galerija Meštrović in Split.

events.title: Vibrez Festival 2026: Laibach
events.summary: Slovenian avant-garde industrial group Laibach performs during Vibrez Festival 2026. The concert is confirmed for 20:00 at Galerija Meštrović in Split.

events.title: Vibrez Festival 2026: Mario Biondi
events.summary: Italian vocalist Mario Biondi brings his soul, R&B, jazz, and swing-influenced repertoire to Vibrez Festival 2026. The concert is confirmed for 20:00 at Galerija Meštrović in Split.

events.title: H2o Croatia Dance Festival
events.summary: Four-day Croatia dance weekender billed around boats, clubs and beach clubs, with house, tech-house, hard-house and disco programming and headline announcements pending.

events.title: Agenda Beach Club Party Croatia
events.summary: Croatia debut of the Agenda Beach Club Party brand, billed as a weekly Adriatic beach-club party with DJs and high-energy house/tech-house programming on 2, 9, 16 and 23 August.

events.title: Split Summer Festival: Papandopulo Quartet
events.summary: Papandopulo Quartet performs at Meštrović's Crikvine - Kaštilac for Split Summer Festival 2026. The program lists works by György Ligeti, Boris Papandopulo, Margareta Ferek Petrić, Philippe Geiss, and George Gershwin.

events.title: Out To Sea Boat Party
events.summary: Recurring Split daytime boat-party brand with live DJs, performers, Adriatic sailing and swim-stop format, listed across August on 2, 6, 9, 13, 16, 20, 23 and 27 August.

events.title: Split Summer Festival: Split String Quartet
events.summary: Split String Quartet performs a chamber program at Meštrović's Crikvine - Kaštilac as part of Split Summer Festival 2026. The listed program includes works by Silvije Bombardelli, Boris Papandopulo, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky.

events.title: Split After Dark
events.venueName: Jimmy Bar / TBC boat and club route
events.summary: Party Hard’s Sunday boat-to-club night in Split, starting at Jimmy Bar with free shots before a live-DJ night boat party and VIP club entry; August dates listed on 2, 9, 16 and 23 August.

events.title: Croatia Pool Party
events.summary: Party Hard Travel’s recurring Saturday Croatia pool-party series for Split’s August 2026 season, listed on 1, 8, 15 and 22 August as part of the Croatia events programme.
